item.title: ROUNDUP: RC wins cross-town hoops games; River Islands boys lock up 1st title
item.description: Ripon Christian is closing in on a sixth consecutive Trans Valley League boys basketball championship after routing rival Ripon 74-49 at home Thursday night.

item.title: Hawks soar past Lathrop in WAC upset
item.description: With two games remaining on the Western Athletic Conference boys soccer schedule, Lathrop entered Thursday night’s game with visiting Central Valley leading second-place Pacheco by three points. After the stunning 2-0 win by the Hawks at Bennie Gatto Field, coupled with Pacheco’s tie, the Spartans now enter the season finale at Beyer on Tuesday with a two-point lead over Pacheco.

item.title: GIRLS HOOPS: Crabb ignites Sierra in blowout of Manteca
item.description: Isabellah Crabb grabbed the loose ball off the opening tip-off won by teammate Emalina Latu and quickly advanced it to the left wing. She didn’t hesitate to launch a 3-pointer. Bang. The Sierra senior was just getting started. That was the first of five 3s she hit in the first quarter alone, sparking the Timberwolves’ electric start to a 59-28 revenge win over visiting intra-city rival Manteca on Thursday.

item.title: Rezaye’s 22 not enough as CC outlasts EU in 1st-place battle
item.description: MODESTO — East Union came into its game at Central Catholic with a chance to secure at least a share of a seventh straight Valley Oak League title on Thursday. The Lancers came up short, 59-48.

item.title: A real pickle: Is converting lighted baseball field at Elliott Park into 12 pickleball courts the right move?
item.description: It’s the $6.5 million question. And how Manteca goes about finding the answer will say a lot about those governing the city.

item.title: State of City venue goes back to downtown’s roots, underlines today’s progress, and gives a preview of the future possibilities
item.description: It is, without a doubt, the ideal venue to showcase the future of downtown Manteca. The Veranda Events Center is the site of the April 29 State of the City.

item.title: Woodward from Moffat to Atherton reopens, sort of
item.description: Woodward Avenue between Moffat Boulevard and Atherton Drive will reopen on a limited trial basis starting Monday, Feb. 9.

item.title: Manteca adds 100 plus auxiliary dwelling units during the past 6 years
item.description: Manteca, in the last six years, has added more than 100 auxiliary dwelling units.

item.title: Manteca Rotary’s 20th Super Bowl Sunday omelet breakfast set for MRPS Hall
item.description: The 20th annual Manteca Rotary Super Bowl Omelet Breakfast takes place Sunday, Feb. 8, from 7:30 to 11:30 a.m. at the MRPS Hall, 133 Grant St.

item.title: $100 CROSS DONORS SOUGHT TO HELP FUND ‘26 COMMEMORATION
item.description: Organizers of the effort to bring back the three-day Memorial Weekend Commemoration to Woodward Park this year after a six-year hiatus are in need of financial support and volunteers.
